Spec-Driven Change Lifecycle (propose -> apply -> sync -> archive)

nodes.label: OpenSpec Store
nodes.rationale: A store is a standalone OpenSpec repo registered on the machine; commands pass --store <id> so specs and changes can live outside the local openspec/ root.

nodes.label: Intelligent Merging Principle
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Sync is agent-driven rather than programmatic so partial updates can be applied: the delta represents intent, not a wholesale replacement, and the operation must stay idempotent while preserving content not mentioned in the delta.

nodes.label: Fluid Workflow (Actions on a Change)
nodes.rationale: Apply is not phase-locked: it can be invoked before all artifacts are done, after partial implementation, or interleaved with other actions, and implementation may feed back into artifact updates when design issues surface.

nodes.label: Explore Mode Stance
nodes.rationale: Explore mode is a stance, not a workflow: thinking, visualizing, and investigating without ever writing application code, so premature implementation is prevented; creating OpenSpec artifacts counts as capturing thinking, not implementing.

nodes.label: Change Artifacts (proposal/design/specs/tasks)
nodes.rationale: A change is planned through artifacts built in dependency order: proposal.md (what & why), design.md (how), delta specs, and tasks.md (implementation steps); apply.requires defines which must exist before implementation.

nodes.label: Update vs. Start Fresh Heuristic
nodes.rationale: If a request changes a change's intent rather than refining it, a fresh change should be started with /opsx:new instead of updating the existing one.

nodes.label: TodoSobreLaUNET Project
nodes.rationale: Informational static website in Spanish about the UNET university: departments, pensum, scholarships, events, projects, and study regulations.

nodes.label: Astro 5 + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 Stack
nodes.rationale: Tailwind 4 is wired via the @tailwindcss/vite plugin in astro.config.mjs; there is no tailwind.config file and global styles plus the Tailwind import live in src/styles/global.css.

nodes.label: File-Based Routing (src/pages)
nodes.rationale: Each .astro file in src/pages/ is a route; route names are Spanish and PascalCase, a convention to keep for new pages.

nodes.label: Content as JSON (src/data)
nodes.rationale: Page content lives in src/data JSON files imported directly by pages/components, so site content changes are made by editing JSON rather than markup.

nodes.label: Mixed Astro/React Components Pattern
nodes.rationale: Static/presentational pieces are .astro components; anything interactive is a React .jsx component that must be given a client:* directive when used from an .astro file to hydrate.
